visual_briefs.title: The index selects one term at a time
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Index-to-term machine plus discrete point graph.
visual_briefs.composition: Index-to-term machine plus discrete point graph.
visual_briefs.interaction: Step through integer inputs; noninteger inputs visibly produce no term.
visual_briefs.long_description: A sequence is a function whose allowed inputs are integers. Each input selects one ordered term.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A sequence is discrete, not a continuous curve
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Index-to-term machine plus discrete point graph.
visual_briefs.composition: Index-to-term machine plus discrete point graph.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The points of a sequence occur only at positive integer inputs. A faint guide curve may reveal a pattern, but the curve is not part of the sequence.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: One sequence, two descriptions
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Side-by-side recurrence chain and direct formula.
visual_briefs.composition: Side-by-side recurrence chain and direct formula.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The same arithmetic sequence can be generated step by step or evaluated directly.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Convergence is eventual trapping
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N.
visual_briefs.composition: Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N.
visual_briefs.interaction: Adjust epsilon and display a valid cutoff N.
visual_briefs.long_description: After a cutoff N, all sequence points lie inside an epsilon-band around L.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Three ways a sequence can fail to settle
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N.
visual_briefs.composition: Tolerance band around L with a visible cutoff N.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A convergent sequence approaches one height. Divergent sequences may oscillate, grow without bound, or wander without approaching one value.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Monotone plus bounded forces convergence
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Increasing staircase beneath a least upper bound.
visual_briefs.composition: Increasing staircase beneath a least upper bound.
visual_briefs.interaction: Iterate a recurrence while showing current bound and monotonicity status.
visual_briefs.long_description: The increasing sequence \(a_n=1-1/n\) can never cross its upper bound \(1\), so its terms are squeezed into a narrowing vertical range.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A series is understood through its partial sums
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Term plot paired with running-total plot.
visual_briefs.composition: Term plot paired with running-total plot.
visual_briefs.interaction: Toggle between terms and partial sums for the same series.
visual_briefs.long_description: The terms of a geometric series shrink, while the partial sums climb toward the finite total \(2\).
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: The remaining tail is a scaled copy
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Self-similar interval filling and a shrinking tail.
visual_briefs.composition: Self-similar interval filling and a shrinking tail.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Lengths one-half, one-quarter, one-eighth, and so on fill a unit interval.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A geometric series repeatedly takes the same fraction
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Self-similar interval filling and a shrinking tail.
visual_briefs.composition: Self-similar interval filling and a shrinking tail.
visual_briefs.interaction: Adjust r and show convergence, oscillation, or term growth.
visual_briefs.long_description: Successive pieces occupy one half of what remains, producing areas \(1/2,1/4,1/8,\ldots\) whose total fills one whole square.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Interior terms cancel; boundary terms survive
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A cancellation chain showing interior terms disappearing while boundary terms remain.
visual_briefs.composition: A cancellation chain showing interior terms disappearing while boundary terms remain.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A finite telescoping partial sum is displayed as shifted positive and negative rows. Matching interior terms cancel, leaving only terms at the two ends.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Small terms can still build an unbounded total
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Compare shrinking harmonic terms with growing harmonic partial sums.
visual_briefs.composition: Compare shrinking harmonic terms with growing harmonic partial sums.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: The terms 1/n decrease toward zero while the corresponding harmonic partial sums continue to rise.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: The p-series threshold occurs at p equals 1
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Partial sums for p=1/2, p=1, and p=2 on matched axes.
visual_briefs.composition: Partial sums for p=1/2, p=1, and p=2 on matched axes.
visual_briefs.interaction: Move p across 1 and compare term decay and partial sums.
visual_briefs.long_description: Three partial-sum curves show rapid growth for p=1/2, slow unbounded growth for p=1, and leveling for p=2.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Decreasing rectangles trap the integral tail
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Decreasing curve with left and right rectangles bracketing the tail.
visual_briefs.composition: Decreasing curve with left and right rectangles bracketing the tail.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A positive decreasing curve is shown with unit-width rectangles. Right-endpoint rectangles lie below the curve and left-endpoint rectangles lie above it.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Series terms and areas under a decreasing curve
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Decreasing curve with left and right rectangles bracketing the tail.
visual_briefs.composition: Decreasing curve with left and right rectangles bracketing the tail.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: For a positive decreasing function, the rectangles associated with \(f(n)\) can be compared directly with the improper integral under \(f(x)\).
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Alternating partial sums form shrinking brackets
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Odd and even partial sums nesting around a common limit.
visual_briefs.composition: Odd and even partial sums nesting around a common limit.
visual_briefs.interaction: Add terms and watch the bracketing interval shrink.
visual_briefs.long_description: Odd and even partial sums lie on opposite sides of the limit and the distance between them equals the next term magnitude.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Alternating partial sums bracket the limit
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Odd and even partial sums nesting around a common limit.
visual_briefs.composition: Odd and even partial sums nesting around a common limit.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: When alternating term magnitudes decrease to zero, odd and even partial sums approach the same value from opposite sides.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: A ratio below one creates geometric domination
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Successive term bars shrinking by an approximately fixed factor.
visual_briefs.composition: Successive term bars shrinking by an approximately fixed factor.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: Successive term magnitudes are shown decreasing by a factor bounded above by a fixed number r less than one.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.

visual_briefs.title: Choose a convergence test from the series structure
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: A decision tree beginning with the term test and branching by structure.
visual_briefs.composition: A decision tree beginning with the term test and branching by structure.
visual_briefs.interaction: No runtime interaction required in the first pass.
visual_briefs.long_description: A flowchart begins with the term limit, then branches to geometric, telescoping, positive-term comparison, alternating, factorial, and nth-power structures.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Preserve the misconception control described in the lesson and storyboard.
